The Social Secretary organizes all social events, post-rehearsal outings, and tours to help everyone in the orchestra get to know one another.

  • Course: 4th Year Physics with Meteorology
  • Instrument: Violin
  • Favourite piece of music: Ballade No. 1 in G minor – Frédéric Chopin
  • Favourite thing about EUSO: Being part of an incredible ensemble and playing accidental solos during rests.

Here are a few words from Jack:

Hello! I'm Jack, I play violin and as social sec this year, I hope we can continue to make EUSO a friendly, inclusive and rewarding society to be a part of, and I'm looking forward to organising different ways to get to know everyone.
